item.title: Indonesia: Couple Caned 140 Times Each by Sharia Police for S*x Outside Marriage and Alcohol
item.description: An Indonesian couple was publicly caned 140 times each on Thursday in the province of Aceh after being found guilty of having sex outside of marriage and consuming alcohol. The punishment, carried out in a public park before dozens of onlookers, is considered one of the most severe sentences handed down since the region began implementing Sharia law over two decades ago.
